## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers Department of Social Services products in the current
`fplida` build: DOMINO/Centrelink administrative data and DEX/Data Exchange.

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked here. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, or generated smoke data. |
| Unresolved | No official or local source was found in this pass. Do not treat as fact. |

## Source documents

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| `inst/plida_metadata/*.csv` | DIL product and variable inventory. |
| `R/generate_domino.R`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_domino.R` | DOMINO product structure, current local schemas, and tested value domains. |
| `R/generate_dex.R`, `src/rust/src/dex.rs`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_batch5.R` | DEX generated schema and tested score behaviour. |
| [DSS metadata for research datasets](https://www.dss.gov.au/doing-business-us/corporate-policies/metadata-research-datasets) | Official DSS statement that DOMINO gives a longitudinal view of social security interactions and that metadata are provided via the Aristotle catalogue. |
| [DOMINO external analytical version](https://dss.aristotlecloud.io/item/1942/dataset/domino-external-analytical-version) | Official Aristotle entry describing the external DOMINO dataset and warning PLIDA users to use the PLIDA version. |
| [DEX policy](https://dex.dss.gov.au/policy) | Official source for Data Exchange reporting context and SCORE/client-outcome framing. |
| [Data Exchange protocols](https://dex.dss.gov.au/sites/default/files/documents/2023-03/1931-data-exchange-protocols.pdf) | Official DEX protocol source for SCORE/client/community outcomes and extended data items. |
| [CHSP DEX protocols](https://dex.dss.gov.au/sites/default/files/documents/2025-09/2646-2536-chsp-dex-protocols.pdf) | Program-specific DEX source that lists available exit-reason categories for CHSP. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| DOMINO | DSS metadata pages and the Aristotle DOMINO entry support the use of DOMINO as longitudinal social-security administrative data and warn PLIDA users to rely on the PLIDA version. | I did not find public variable-level Aristotle pages for every generated benefit, component, end-reason, medical, housing, and education code used by the local generator. |
| DEX | DEX policy and protocol documents are official anchors for service/session reporting, extended data, SCORE, and outcome framing. | Generated assistance, exit-reason, demographic, and SCORE fields still need exact protocol-table-to-variable mapping before labels are treated as official. |

## Product inventory

The PLIDA metadata lists two DSS datasets and thirty-six products.

| Dataset | Metadata products | Current fplida coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| `DOMINO` | 35 | Fourteen generated DOMINO tables covering benefit spells, demographics, income, locations, education, housing, medical assessments, payment-history families, Indigenous status, and principal-carer relationships. |
| `DEX` | 1 | One generated extended DEX service/session product. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-dss.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-dss.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and direct PLIDA metadata matches. Treat those sampled
domains/distributions as implementation evidence only, not as official source
data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/dss-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/dss-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

A stricter source-audited variable-code evidence register is available at
[`dss-variable-code-evidence.csv`](dss-variable-code-evidence.csv), with a
rendered companion note at
[`dss-variable-code-evidence.qmd`](dss-variable-code-evidence.qmd). Use that
register to distinguish DOMINO/DEX public concept support, local PLIDA/generator
evidence, and public-codebook-not-found rows.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | No direct PLIDA name match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `DEX` | 14 | 2 | 12 |
| `DOMINO` | 130 | 128 | 2 |

Rows without a direct PLIDA match need a generated-name to DIL-name crosswalk
before they are treated as source variables. `generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`
now maps all twelve compact DEX no-direct-match fields to same-dataset DEX
metadata variables, and maps the two generated DOMINO death date components
back to `DATE_OF_DEATH`. Those mappings do not supply official code labels;
they only establish the local DIL/source-variable concept.

## DOMINO generated schema and domains

The DOMINO generator states that code values use DSS Aristotle Metadata
Registry codes. This guide still records them as local generator evidence
unless the specific variable-level Aristotle page is linked here.

### Benefit spells: `det_ben`

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_AEUID` | Character ID | DSS agency person key. | Local generator |
| `BEN_TYPE_CODE` | Categorical/code | Tested/generated universe includes `DSP`, `NSA`, `JSP`, `YAL`, `PPP`, `PPS`, `AGE`, `CAR`, `CDA`, `ABY`, `AUS`, `FTB`, `BRV`, `BSW`, `DWS`, `MEP`, `MOB`, `WFD`, `WFR`, and other Centrelink benefit codes in the local test list. | Local generator/test; DSS Aristotle should be linked before publishing labels |
| `BEN_STATUS` | Categorical | Tested domain `CUR`, `SUS`. | Local generator/test |
| `PERIOD_START_DATE`, `PERIOD_END_DATE` | Date | Benefit spell start/end. | Local generator |
| `DURN_DAYS` | Integer | Spell duration in days. | Local generator |
| `END_RSN`, `END_RSN_CODE` | Categorical/code | Local smoke examples include `CAN`, `SUS` and codes such as `6WK`, `ADE`, `AGE`, `APR`, `ASS`, `CLR`, `EMP`, `FSD`, `INC`, `NFR`, `NRQ`, `OTH`. | Local generator; official labels unresolved |

## DEX generated schema and domains

The official DEX policy source is the right evidence for SCORE interpretation.
The local generator only produces a compact service/session product.

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_AEUID` | Character ID | DSS agency person key. | Local generator |
| `BIRTH_YEAR`, `BIRTH_MONTH` | Integer | Birth year/month; month should be 1 to 12. | Local generator |
| `GENDER_CODE`, `ATSI_CODE` | Categorical/code | Demographic fields projected from spine. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalks to `GENDERCODE` and `ATSICODE`; official labels unresolved |
| `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH` | Code | Country-of-birth code. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalk to `BIRTHCOUNTRYCODE` |
| `EDUCATION_LEVEL`, `EMPLOYMENT_STATUS` | Categorical/code | Generated from spine education/employment inputs. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalks to `EDUCATIONLEVELCODE` and `EMPLOYMENTSTATUSCODE` |
| `SESSION_DATE` | Date | Service/session date. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalk to `CONDUCTEDDATE` |
| `ASSISTANCE_TYPE` | Categorical/code | Generated assistance type. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalk to `PRIMARYASSISTANCENEEDEDKEY`; official DEX assistance code list unresolved |
| `SCORE_PRE`, `SCORE_POST` | Integer | Tested range 1 to 5; local test requires `SCORE_POST >= SCORE_PRE`. | Local generator/test; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalk to `OUTCOMEDOMAINSCORE`; official SCORE meaning from DEX policy |
| `EXIT_REASON` | Categorical/code | Generated exit reason. | Local generator; same-dataset DEX metadata crosswalk to `EXITREASONCODE`; official labels unresolved |
| `STATE_ASGS_2021` | Integer/code | State/territory on ASGS 2021 basis. | Local generator |

## Research uses and limits

DOMINO is the main welfare/social-security longitudinal product. It can support
spell construction, benefit histories, housing/education context, and
payment-history examples. DEX is currently suitable for service-interaction
examples and SCORE mechanics, but not for detailed DEX program taxonomy until
assistance-type and exit-reason codebooks are linked.

## Build implications

1. DOMINO code values should stay close to the DSS Aristotle registry; add
   variable-level links for high-use benefit, component, and end-reason codes.
2. DEX should not be used as a general welfare receipt source; use DOMINO for
   payments and DEX for service sessions/outcomes.
3. Add explicit tests for DEX category domains beyond SCORE once a DEX code
   table is sourced.
